title: Gender Bias in Explainability: Investigating Performance Disparity in Post-hoc Methods

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating performance disparities in post-hoc feature attribution explanations (such as LIME, SHAP, and Integrated Gradients) between male and female text inputs. The evaluation measures explanation quality using metrics for faithfulness, robustness, and complexity, and quantifies the disparity between gender subgroups using the Mann-Whitney U test and Cohen's d effect size across datasets like GECO, COMPAS, and a synthetic Stereotypes dataset.
